_about: Public-domain E. W. Hengstenberg (1802-1869, Lutheran, professor at Berlin) in pre-1930 English translations from T. & T. Clark and American houses: Christology of the Old Testament (4 vols, tr. Theodore Meyer and James Martin, 1861-68), Commentary on the Psalms (3 vols, 4th ed., 1863-64, tr. John Thomson and Patrick Fairbairn), The Revelation of St John (2 vols, tr. Patrick Fairbairn, 1851-52), Ecclesiastes (tr. D. W. Simon, 1860), Egypt and the Books of Moses (tr. R. D. C. Robbins, 1843) and the Gospel of St John (2 vols, 1865), raw Internet Archive OCR. These are the translations the fairbairn shelf leaves out as other men's books; they belong here. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 15 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
